data_provenance: Δ-scores from live Liganx baseline (spike #5). Sotorasib is COVALENT — Vina's non-covalent scoring underweights the true binding event, so the Δ here reads the residual geometric component. Documented method limit; ESM2 + literature prior expected to recover.

predicted_resistance.rationale: Already documented as Sotorasib resistance in patients (Awad 2021, NEJM). Mutant-receptor build for Y96D failed in baseline — pending pipeline fix (see commit reverting the FoldX-only path).

Negative-control entry. Sotorasib was rationally designed to selectively engage the C12 thiol via Michael addition; the strongly negative Δ confirms the drug binds the mutant much tighter than WT. This row exists so the atlas is honest about which alterations the drug TARGETS vs which it loses to.

covalent_caveat: Sotorasib's binding to G12C is COVALENT (acrylamide → C12 thiol via Michael addition). Vina is non-covalent and under-represents the covalent-bond contribution. Rigid-receptor Δ alone is the WRONG tool for forecasting Sotorasib resistance — the atlas's literature-prior + ESM2 layers carry more weight here.
ledger_note: Sotorasib was approved May 2021. First documented clinical resistance: Y96D (Awad et al., NEJM 2021). Atlas v1 captures known resistance via literature prior; v2 ESM2 + accessibility integration will surface NOVEL residues at risk.
